originalOracle: assert(duplicate.generation === revised.generation && digest(duplicate.observations.map(o => o.ref)) === digest(revised.observations.map(o => o.ref)) && beforeDuplicate === afterDuplicate, 'R2_DUPLICATE_PUBLICATION');
cause: JSON.stringify(ref object) depends on insertion order; PostgreSQL JSONB returns the same named fields in a different order. Original digest comparison fails for semantically identical references.
correctedRule: Compare sorted tuples [occurrenceId,evidenceId,contentHash] in sorted lists; independently assert generation, native evidence version count, occurrences and current projection.
preserved: No original script, source content/hash/timestamps, negative, business state or R1 data is changed. No original R2 execute, worker, confirmation, approval, analysis or real model is repeated.

remainingAuthorizedMutation.input: Exact existing v2 evidence read from the frozen native occurrence; no content/timestamp change.
remainingAuthorizedMutation.expected: Additional command/occurrence receipt is legitimate; current refs and generation2 stay identical, evidence versions remain2.

proofLimits: Original duplicate return value and native session digests not retained after process failure. Do not reconstruct.
STALE_CONTEXT refusals were asserted before the recorded later failure, not persisted as successful decisions and not replayed.
